description: Convert Advantage Games from a static/QC showcase into the authenticated production host for all five APK cartridges, with a generic student route, server-owned persistence, and a continuous arcade loop.
deviation_notes: W0 and W1 proved package cartridges and QC. W2 composed those packages into the dynamic authenticated host without porting another game batch. Browser QA exposed an async StrictMode double-canvas race and an unstable edition-object remount; both were fixed. Mandatory review found base-path fetch and browser-matrix gaps; both were fixed in 839cdc23. The product owner explicitly instructed completion and continuation after agent-driven browser evidence; this is authorization to proceed, not a claim that the product owner personally operated the browser.

sprint.goal: A student can sign in to Advantage Games, play any of the five shared APK cartridges through one production host, persist a completion safely, and continue directly to another game.
sprint.demo_notes: Automated and agent-driven browser QA passes for login, all-five generic host routing, one-canvas lifecycle, concurrent persistence, responsive layout, and deterministic continuation. Product owner authorized completion and continuation on 2026-07-11.
